correctness.rationale: Independent type B root subconfigurations have only elementary 2-torsion; this makes each genuinely two-sided join increase the quotient annihilator exponent by at most one. The dimension recurrence and the barycentric decomposition argument then give exponent floor((d-1)/2).

originality.rationale: Vallée proves only existence of a uniform exponent via maximal simplex volume. Targeted searches found no explicit floor((d-1)/2) bound or quotient-exponent refinement for type B generalized permutohedra.

value.rationale: The result converts a finiteness-based saturation statement into an explicit intrinsic-dimension bound and determines the optimal universal exponent in dimensions three and four.
